Object deletion

Software presentation ››

Deleting a a graphical object.


Two possibilities with the upper toolbar :


Tool : Click on the object which is to be suppressed. If the object deletion implies the deletion of other objects you will be prompted for agreement.


Protocol tool . A dialog box will popup with all the created objects (numerical and graphical) displayed in a list. Select the object in the list the click on icon .




Deleting a numerical object.


Two possibilities with the upper toolbar :


Tool of numerical objects modification. A dialog box will popup with all the numerical objects displayed in a list. You can click on the Delete button to get the selected object suppressed.


Protocol tool . A dialog box will popup with all the created objects (numerical and graphical) displayed in a list. You can click on the  button  to get the selected object suppressed.
